category_title: Students with severe hearing impairment and EAL who use physical gestures and lip-reading to decipher archaic language
minimal_context: The student is participating in a focus group discussion about group work and drama activities.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to start our group work for the drama activity. Please join your assigned group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains very quiet and does not move toward the assigned group, looking visibly uncomfortable about the group work.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and join them. You need to work together on this.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gestures with great earnestness, trying hard to communicate his feelings about joining the group.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am not sure what you mean. What are you trying to say?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Nope... No. (. . .) um (.) sometime um there are people that they are don’t take the [cope]... Cope (.) cope... Crope (.) crope (.) crope
